messages.subject: For Gabriel Podskubka | Government relations, local value and regional energy growth
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Bravo,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Gabriel Podskubka, Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Tenaris is expanding across energy markets where government relationships, local supplier development, infrastructure and long-term stakeholder confidence matter. Its recent activity in the Guianas makes that intersection especially relevant to my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex resource and infrastructure operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, local-value strategy and emerging-market execution could support Tenaris across the Guianas and wider international markets. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Tenaris.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
